items.headline: October 20 council agenda listed Environmental Planning Commission applicant interviews
items.summary: The City Council's October 20 study session agenda listed interviews of applicants for the Environmental Planning Commission, the body that reviews local development and planning matters.

items.headline: Station Area Task Force agenda: draft specific plan and Benton-Brokaw crossing study
items.summary: The October 15 Santa Clara Station Area Task Force agenda listed a review of the complete draft Specific Plan for the station area. It also listed a public hearing on a feasibility study for a Benton-Brokaw multimodal crossing.

items.headline: AT&T seeks to add antennas to utility poles near Guinda and Homer
items.summary: The Architectural Review Board's October 15 agenda listed a public hearing on AT&T's request to add antennas, radio units and seven-foot fiberglass pole extensions to two city-owned wood utility poles. The poles are in the public right-of-way near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue.

items.headline: Council agenda: El Niño, Anderson Dam, and Pure Water updates
items.summary: The October 13 City Council agenda listed a joint update on El Niño preparedness for the 2026-2027 rainy season. It also listed updates on the Anderson Dam Seismic Retrofit and Coyote Creek Flood Protection projects, and on the Pure Water Silicon Valley potable reuse project.

items.headline: Council agenda lists release of Cubberley purchase-offer documents
items.summary: The City Council's October 13 agenda included an item on the potential release of documents related to an offer to purchase the Cubberley Community Center property. The agenda gave no information on who made the offer or on its terms.

items.headline: Peery Park plan amendment would add offices, R&D space, homes, and move water tower
items.summary: The Planning Commission's October 12 special study session agenda listed a proposed amendment to the Peery Park Specific Plan to increase office and R&D square footage and residential units, and to allow relocation of the Libby Water Tower. The meeting also served as a scoping session for public comment on a Supplemental EIR to the 2016 Peery Park plan's environmental report.

items.headline: Mountain View council listed City Attorney candidate interviews in closed session
items.summary: The City Council's 8:00 a.m. closed session agenda for October 10 listed a public employee appointment for the City Attorney position, with candidate interviews. The agenda shows the city was recruiting for the post.
